name: Be a Man
source: You interpret the role of a young man who fell in love with a beautiful woman. Help him to get to the woman. [From [url=http://renai.us/game/be-a-man.shtml]Ren'Ai Archive[/url]]
translation: 你將扮演一名愛上美麗女子的年輕人。幫助他接近這位女子。[來自[url=http://renai.us/game/be-a-man.shtml]Ren'Ai Archive[/url]]
